name: workbench
description: Five independent explicit Workbench skills for evidence-backed analysis, task planning, isolated execution, artifact persistence, and integrated-change validation.

interface.shortDescription: Independent tools for software change analysis and execution.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently useful, explicitly invoked skills. Analyze a change, create a task plan from any sufficient definition, execute one bounded task in an isolated Git worktree, persist one selected completed artifact, or review one immutable integrated Git change. No skill requires or advertises another Workbench skill.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to investigate this software change and return a standalone report.
Use $workbench:prepare to create an isolated execution plan from this change definition.
Use $workbench:execute-task to execute this bounded task in a dedicated Git worktree.
